critical_code_review_comments: Good use of data-testid attributes throughout for testability
Auto-save with 500ms debounce implemented correctly using useRef for cleanup
Timer state persisted to backend every 30 seconds for resume functionality
Email lowercased on backend for consistent lookup
MongoDB _id excluded from all responses using projection
Admin endpoints properly protected with verify_admin middleware
CSV export flattens nested answers object correctly
Completion percentage calculated server-side for consistency

context_for_next_testing_agent: Candidate Assessment System fully tested. Public route /assessment for candidates (no auth). Admin route /admin/assessments (requires super_admin role). 32 questions total - Q2, Q4, Q6, Q8 are radio buttons, rest are textareas. Timer starts at 90:00 (5400 seconds), auto-saves every 30s. Answers auto-save with 500ms debounce. Resume works by email lookup. Admin can filter by status, search by name/email, sort columns, export JSON/CSV. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_assessments.py covers all API endpoints.
